title: Low Visibility
headline: Fog lowers visibility. Slow down and make yourself visible.
quick: Slow down and use low-beam headlights
notification: Foggy out there. Drive slowly and use your low beams.

extras: Light scarf or mask if air is damp or hazy

do: Wear a mask if air feels heavy or hazy
Keep windows closed if humidity is high

best: Slow walks in a safe park

travel: Low beams and fog lights only
Slow down and keep a wide gap
Delay travel if visibility is very low
home: Use a dehumidifier if air feels damp

people.kids: Bright clothes, hold hands near roads, and avoid walking alone.
people.elderly: Wait for the fog to lift before going out.
people.pets: Use a light-up collar and keep them on a leash.
people.commuters: Leave early; allow extra time and use visible transit.
people.athletes: Train indoors or on a treadmill; roads are risky.

rules.tip: Very low visibility: delay non-essential driving.
Use low beams and reduce speed by a third.
Morning fog usually lifts by late morning; consider waiting.
Poor air quality: wear a mask and limit time outside.

commonMistakes: Following the taillights of the car ahead too closely
